messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: metering.alert -> billing_emitter_count_delta > 12% (15m), repeated over-count spikes + delayed usage emits. Paging on-call: @jamal. Link: https://redwood.corp/alerts/1759999998 :rotating_light:
jamal: Acked. I’m on it — jumping into emitter logs and Redis metrics now.
jamal: Quick check: emitter-queue length ~3.2k, retry rate spiked at 02:14 UTC, many duplicate delivery attempts.
priay: (typo) @jamal wanted to say — priya: pinging billing-eng for visibility, could be dedupe regressing after last deploy.
billing-eng: saw the alert, joining. We rolled a small change to emitter retry logic ~02:05 UTC (release 2026.03.20-emit). Rolling back?
alex: initial SQL: `SELECT count(*) FROM usage_events WHERE received_at > now() - interval '1 hour' AND source = 'emitter'` shows +14% vs baseline. Sample grouping shows duplicates with same request_id.
jamal: log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T02:14:12Z emitter WARN retrying request_id=6f8a... status=timeout
2026-03-20T02:14:12Z emitter INFO sent request_id=6f8a... tokens=340
2026-03-20T02:14:13Z emitter INFO duplicate detected request_id=6f8a...
```
jamal: hypothesis: backoff change in 2026.03.20-emit removed jitter -> thundering retries -> duplicates + delayed ack to primary ledger -> late emits.
maya: Oncall suggestion: enable `EMITTER_DEDUPE=true` flag from runbook, and scale emitter workers x2 to drain backlog. Runbook: https://redwood.corp/runbooks/metering-dedup
jamal: executing: `kubectl set env deployment/emitter EMITTER_DEDUPE=true -n prod` and `k scale deploy emitter --replicas=6 -n prod`
jamal: done. Observability: queue length dropping from 3200 -> 900 in 4m. Retry rate down 78%.
priay: good. Are customers seeing overage flags? Any active billing alerts?
alex: Customer-impact query: `SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE received_at > now() - interval '2 hours' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY sum DESC LIMIT 10;` shows 4 customers with +20-40% token delta vs rolling baseline. Those have provisional overage flags emitted between 02:10-02:20 UTC.
billing-eng: flagging that those flags may be false positives. We should hold billing actions until recon. Suggest adding temporary suppress rule for flags emitted between 02:00-02:30 UTC.
maya: I can file a suppression in the billing rules UI. Drafting policy: ignore overage triggers where source=emitter AND event_time between 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-20T02:30:00Z.
priay: @maya go ahead, include trace id for manual audit. Notify CS to hold any billing outreach.
maya: suppression applied (rule id sup-20260320-1). Notified #customer-impact.
jamal: next: start a targeted reconciliation job to collapse duplicates by request_id for the window 01:50-02:30. Alex, can you run reconcile-job-adhoc?
alex: running `python tools/reconcile_duplicates.py --start "2026-03-20T01:50:00Z" --end "2026-03-20T02:30:00Z" --by request_id` now. ETA ~14m. Output will produce a delta CSV for billing adjustments.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident severity set to P2 due to possible customer-visible billing noise. Pager duty incident link: https://redwood.corp/incidents/1759999998
jamal: we should prepare customer comms in case manual credits required. Priya, can you draft an abbreviated message for affected customers?
priay: Draft: "We detected transient duplication in usage reporting affecting a small subset of customers between 02:00–02:30 UTC. We are preventing automated billing actions and reconciling counts now. We'll follow up within 4 hours with remediation/credits where needed." WIP in #customer-impact-drafts.
billing-eng: once reconcile CSV is ready we can generate adjustments and queue for ops review.
alex: reconcile finished. Produced `reconcile_1759999998_delta.csv` (attached to incident ticket). Net token delta for top affected custs: [-12%, -9%, -25%, -3%].
jamal: great — schedule a quick ops review: @maya, can you approve adjustments for production run?
maya: approving now. Apply adjustments job kicking off: `./apply_adjustments --file reconcile_1759999998_delta.csv --dry-run=false`
maya: adjustments completed. Posted summary in incident ticket.
priay: sent first-pass customer note to the four customers. CS confirmed no escalations yet.
jamal: closing steps: keep dedupe flag on until next deploy, add jitter back to retry algorithm (PR already opened: https://redwood.corp/pulls/8142), and add postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated — queue drained, dedupe enabled, suppression applied. Incident severity downgraded to P3.
jamal: filing postmortem — assigning owners: retry-jitter -> billing-eng, reconcile playbook -> alex, customer comms -> priya.
priay: marking incident resolved for paging. Will post follow-up summary in #all-hands after postmortem publishes. :white_check_mark:
